headline: V-Guard posts 71 percent surge in second-quarter profit
hook: Strongest quarterly profit jump in recent quarters
summary: V-Guard Industries reported a net profit of over ₹111 crore for the second quarter of financial year 2027, marking a 71 percent increase compared to the same period previous year. Revenue from operations grew 38.2 percent year-on-year to reach ₹1,852.89 crore during the quarter. The robust financial performance reflects strong operational momentum and demand for the company's electrical and consumer goods. Indian retail investors holding V-Guard shares benefit from expanding margins and top-line growth.
why_it_matters: Strong earnings boost near-term sentiment for V-Guard shareholders.
winners_losers: V-Guard shareholders gain / competitors face margin pressure
